intro: Tutorial: tap a control to read what it does, or switch to Play to use BabbleBeat. On the FM-1 itself, holding GLO shows a guide like this on its own screen.
master: MASTER sets output volume in every page.
screen: The upper text is the current generated sentence. The waveform is a sentence-derived score; its moving playhead follows phoneme playback. The bottom labels follow the actual knob layout.

words.title: WORDS
keys: White keys: sixteen phrases, one a key. A key says its phrase (the first press makes it), lower keys in a lower voice; the key last played is the phrase the other controls work on. Black keys: eleven mutators that change that phrase and say it, left to right: NEW NOUN, SWAP NOUNS, NEW ADJECTIVE, REBUILD, NEGATE, TENSE, ASK, ADD CLAUSE, RECALL, STUTTER, DROP.

KNOB1: High: preserve grammar while mutating; low: allow token duplication and deletion.
KNOB2: Chance to pull nouns from other themed worlds.
KNOB3: Likelihood of using the noun remembered with REC.
KNOB4: How frequently generation automatically mutates syntax.
SELECT: Four vocabulary banks: Machine, Dream, Body, and Gothic.
ALGORITHM: Chance of adding a second clause at high values.
PRESETS: Statement-only at low settings, mixed at centre, questions at high settings.

voice.title: VOICE
keys: White keys: sixteen phrases, one a key. A key says its phrase (the first press makes it), lower keys in a lower voice; the key last played is the phrase the other controls work on. Black keys: eleven mutators that change that phrase and say it, left to right: NEW NOUN, SWAP NOUNS, NEW ADJECTIVE, REBUILD, NEGATE, TENSE, ASK, ADD CLAUSE, RECALL, STUTTER, DROP.

KNOB1: Base pitch for autonomously spoken phrases.
KNOB3: A darker, larger voice to a brighter, smaller one.
ALGORITHM: Chance of repeating individual pronunciation codes.
PRESETS: Pitch contour across the successive words of a phrase.

EDIT.label: WORDS
EDIT.text: Select the sentence engine's knobs. No hold required.

FX.label: VOICE
FX.text: Select the synthesizer's voice knobs. No hold required.

PLAY.label: BABBLE
PLAY.text: Babbles: new phrases one after another on the key last played. Press again, or HOME, to stop.

SEQ.label: NEW PHRASE
SEQ.text: Makes a new phrase on the key last played, and says it.

ARP.label: MUTATE
ARP.text: Mutates the phrase on the key last played with a mutation chosen by chance, and says it. The black keys choose the mutation.

REC.label: REMEMBER
REC.text: Keep one noun from this sentence as a possible subject or object in later sentences.

HOME.label: STOP
HOME.text: Stop speaking and turn off autoplay.

OCT-.label: VOICE DOWN
OCT-.text: The whole voice down an octave.

OCT+.label: VOICE UP
OCT+.text: The whole voice up an octave.

SAVE.unused: SAVE is not available: there is no saving yet.

GLO.label: GUIDE
GLO.text: Held down, the screen itself shows what every button does, laid out as the buttons are, with a line for the keys. Let go to return. Nothing else changes while it is held.
